transformations.rationale: The Rust method receiver `self` is represented as the explicit Verus parameter `slice`; the public target remains executable and carries the generated permutation plus comparator-observation sortedness contract.

The Rust 1.96 body passes `&mut |a, b| compare(a, b) == Ordering::Less`. This Verus build does not support a closure that captures a mutable FnMut comparator, so the harness lowers that closure to a named comparator-observation boundary while preserving the source-backed unstable-sort call intent.

The recursive/private unstable-sort implementation behind `sort::unstable::sort` is isolated as a named source-backed helper boundary. The public target function is executable and not `external_body`.
